aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.caption: Web Designer & Front-End Developer
aboutMe.description:
I'm Mehdi, a front-end developer who found his way here by actually building things.

I never followed the conventional path. At some point I realized traditional schooling wasn't going to get me where I wanted to go, so I chose to learn on my own instead — going through courses, reading documentation, and figuring out what actually works by building it myself, one project at a time.

Front-end wasn't some random pick, either. I wanted a skill with real opportunities behind it — both for finding work and for taking on projects independently — and web development fit that. Somewhere along the way, what started as a practical decision turned into something I'm genuinely into: taking an idea and making it real on screen, down to the smallest detail.

This site is one example of that — built and refined by hand. I'm also currently working on a more complex project, an admin dashboard that's still in progress, but it's the kind of thing I take seriously: real structure, real state management, not just a demo.

I'm not pretending to have more experience than I do. But I show up for this every day, I care about getting the details right, and I'm looking for a place where that effort can actually go somewhere.

services.title: Services
services.caption: Professional web design and front-end development services tailored to your needs.

webDevelopment.title: Web Design & Development
webDevelopment.description: Building websites from the ground up — clean structure, modern design, and a layout that works just as well on phones, tablets, and desktops.

frontend.title: UI Implementation from Design Files
frontend.description: Turning design files into real, working pages — matching every detail across screen sizes, not just the desktop view.

pageDesign.title: Development with React or Next.js
pageDesign.description: Building interactive interfaces with React — components organized in a way that's easy to extend, not just code that works for now.

reactNext.title: State Management with Redux
reactNext.description: Managing state in apps where a simple useState isn't enough — keeping data in sync across different parts of the interface.

bugFixing.title: Bug Fixing
bugFixing.description: Finding and fixing frontend issues — the button that doesn't behave, the layout that breaks on a certain screen, the thing that's just not working right.

fullProject.title: Support for Bigger Projects
fullProject.description: When a project needs more than frontend, I handle that part myself and bring in the right people for the rest — like backend or SEO — so everything works together.
